name: underwater

stages.name: 水面の向こう
stages.description: 光の揺れる水中へ潜る
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, diver descending beneath a shimmering ocean surface, shafts of turquoise light, floating bubbles

stages.name: 珊瑚の庭
stages.description: 色鮮やかな生命の世界に出会う
stages.prompt: beautiful anime underwater illustration, colorful coral garden, schools of fish, luminous clear water

stages.name: 沈んだ神殿

stages.prompt: anime fantasy illustration, ancient temple ruins beneath the sea, drifting particles, mysterious blue light

stages.name: 深海の光
stages.description: 暗闇の中で小さな光が輝く
stages.prompt: dreamlike anime illustration, bioluminescent creatures in the deep ocean, glowing cyan and violet, immense darkness

stages.name: 浮上
stages.description: 水面の向こうに太陽を見つける
stages.prompt: cinematic anime illustration, looking upward toward a bright ocean surface, golden sunbeams, bubbles rising, hopeful atmosphere

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout the full music video: dark teal hair floating in soft layers, bright turquoise eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a marine rescue diver exploring submerged reefs and shipwrecks. Fixed signature outfit: a streamlined deep-blue wetsuit with aqua panels, compact oxygen rig, and fin boots. Defining personal item: a waterproof rescue beacon with a glowing coral marker. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in deep sea canyon, coral garden, sunken temple; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with deep ocean blue, teal, bioluminescent cyan, violet; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by underwater wide shot, slow floating camera, macro bubbles and coral; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
